QUOTE: "unless the repo declares an `index_scope:` in its `.clew.yaml`, clew indexes the whole repository"; "nothing declared (the default) ── whole_repo_scope(repo)"; "derive_scope alone falls back to whole-repo"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer gives the declared `index_scope` priority and says that both a missing declaration and (in `derive_scope`) an unusable one fall back to the whole repository. It adds that the CLI refuses an unusable declaration, but the fallthrough itself is stated.
